title: On Operators on Polynomials Preserving Real-Rootedness and the Neggers-Stanley Conjecture

items.abstract: We provide the first counterexamples to Neggers’ 1978 conjecture and Stembridge’s 1997 conjecture that the generating functions for descents and peaks in the linear extensions of naturally labeled posets should have all real zeros. We also provide minimum-sized counterexamples to a generalization of the Neggers conjecture due to Stanley that was recently disproved by Brändén.
title: Counterexamples to the poset conjectures of Neggers, Stanley, and Stembridge

items.abstract: The Neggers-Stanley conjecture asserts that the polynomial counting the linear extensions of a labeled finite partially ordered set by the number of descents has real zeros only. We provide counterexamples to this conjecture.
title: Counterexamples to the Neggers-Stanley conjecture
